Initech — Q3 2026 Business Review

Acme Digital × Initech Software · Presented October 21, 2026 (video call with Austin and Mexico City) · Period: July 1 – September 30, 2026 · All amounts in USD.

Q3 at a Glance

  • 1,480 leads, 575 MQLs and 146 SQLs from paid programs in the US and Mexico.
  • $3.21M in new marketing-sourced pipeline.
  • Q3 spend of $105,060, for a blended CPL of $70.99.
  • Mexico generated 34% of Q3 SQLs (50 of 146).

LinkedIn costs more per lead but produced 101 of the 146 Q3 SQLs. Google Search stays efficient for high-intent "AP automation" queries.

What Worked

  • AP Automation ROI Calculator: 211 leads in Q3 and the best MQL rate of any asset.
  • LinkedIn Document Ads with benchmark charts drove 41% of Q3 MQLs.
  • Spanish-language content for Mexico: cost per SQL in Mexico was 31% lower than in the US.

What Didn't Work

  • Google Display prospecting: $6,300 spent in Q3 with zero SQLs.
  • Generic "Request a demo" ads on LinkedIn: CPL above $140 and a weak MQL rate.
  • Long forms: the 9-field form on the US landing page converted at 4.1%, versus 9.6% for the 5-field version.

Q4 Priorities

  • Launch an ABM program for 150 target accounts in the US (companies with 500–2,000 employees).
  • Run a second Spanish-language webinar for Mexico in November.
  • Revise HubSpot lead scoring with Initech Marketing Ops to cut early-stage MQLs.
  • Test YouTube in-stream ads for the Controller persona.
